videos.title: The Time an Airplane Hit a Bird at Cruising Altitude (11,000 METERS)
videos.author: MinuteEarth
videos.description:
In 1973, an airliner struck a bird called a Rüppell's griffon vulture at a cruising height of over 11,000 meters(!!!). That’s WAY above the height at which most birds fly.  🦅

Sorry if this increases any flying anxiety y'all might have 🥲
